rationale: The stock gapped up ~13% on heavy relative volume (6.6x) and is now consolidating near the upper portion of today's range (78.8%), but the 9-EMA at $48.61 is above the current price of $48.34, suggesting short-term momentum has softened. The broader market is under severe stress (SPY -3.97%, VIXY +25.27%), which creates conflicting signals — the gap-up thesis could reverse sharply in a risk-off tape, yet the stock has held well above its open. With 87 minutes to close, no clear directional edge, and a choppy 1-minute tape oscillating in a tight $0.27 range, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
